integrity: The proof derives the full cyclic-subgroup Hasse structure outside the abelian kernel, applies the published nilpotent comparison theorem to the kernel, and proves the remaining cyclic arithmetic inequality from the published coprime product formula. Bounded enumeration is used only as a replay.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to generalized dicyclic groups with finite abelian kernel and a distinguished involution.
It does not settle the cyclic-subgroup edge-minimality conjecture for arbitrary finite groups of even order.
An equivalent statement could exist in unindexed literature under alternate generalized-dicyclic notation.
title: Cyclic-subgroup edge minimality for generalized dicyclic groups
